Name: Seasonal Floral Bus Recolor
Author: herbivoor
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=3][center][/center][center]﻿﻿My first mod! ^-^
Please let me know if you run into any problems.

﻿- ❀ - ❀ -

Pam's been stretching her green thumb! This mod is a simple texture replacer for the bus in pleasing pastels with added flower detail. Intended to fit with the colors and themes of mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2064]Flower Valley[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval Buildings[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Foliage Redone[/url]﻿. The bus and flower colors change with the seasons, including a light dusting of snow in winter. 

﻿﻿- ❀ - ❀ -

[u]Requirements[/u]
﻿
Only requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, although might look a little washed out in a vanilla save - check out the section under credits for the map recolor I use.
 [/center][center]﻿- ❀ - ❀ -

[u]Installation[/u]

You can find a complete basics guide to modding [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]here[/url]﻿. For the vast majority of mods (including all of mine), simply follow that guide and then extract the .rar or .zip file provided by the modder into your Mods folder.

﻿- ❀ - ❀ -
 [/center][center][u]Compatibility

[/u]This mod should override any mods that change the bus via tilesheets, such as Flower Valley or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿, but will conflict with other mods which only change the bus - attempting to load this mod with a similar dedicated bus replacer installed will most likely cause crashes on opening the game. You have been warned! 

Should work perfectly in multiplayer, but both users will need to have the mod installed if they both want the bus to be replaced.

﻿- ❀ - ❀ -

[u]Credits

[/u]An enormous thank you to my lovely datefriend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/96885498]seitanicbean[/url]﻿ for helping with all the complicated json stuff.
